Comedian born 14 years prior to the year the series mentioned above was aired.

- Identify a series satisfying: aired between 2000 and 2015 inclusive; horror series; less than 10 episodes as of Dec 31 2023.
- The series has a showrunner who is also founder of a talent management company (same company).
- The talent management company is the one under which an interracial comedian released his first stand-up comedy special in early 2020s.
- The comedian's birth year is 14 years prior to the year the series aired. Need relation: year series aired. If series aired in a year? "the year the series mentioned above was aired" maybe series aired between range, so year of airing. Need preserve temporal attachment.
- Identify person who played role of Nurse in that series.
- Full name of that person.

Need not combine independent? We can keep requirements coherent. How many? Maybe 6.

Need preserve role identity uncertainty. "One of the showrunners of the said series is also the founder..." This asserts same person? "is also" means showrunner = founder. Preserve.

"this same talent management company" same as founded by showrunner. "under this same talent management company" released special.

"interracial comedian" attribute. "his first stand-up comedy special" release in early 2020s under company. The comedian born 14 years prior to year series aired.

Need include intermediate identification/existence objectives: identify series; identify its showrunner-founder; identify talent management company; identify comedian and special; identify nurse role actor; full name.

But candidate requirements should not be search queries. We can phrase "The series is..." etc. Need JSON only.

Should we include "The series aired in a year" rather than date. Since final birth condition depends on year the series aired. The question has series aired between 2000 and 2015 inclusive. Need preserve exact range. Could be aired in a year within range. The comedian born 14 years prior to the year the series was aired. That implies series aired in a specific year? If a series aired over multiple years? Original says "the year the series mentioned above was aired." But Q1 says "a series that aired between 2000 and 2015 inclusive" maybe first aired? Need preserve as stated. We can say "The year in which the series aired (within 2000–2015 inclusive) is the reference year for the comedian's birth year; the comedian was born 14 years before that year." That combines Q1 range and Q5 relation. But maybe keep separate? Requirement: "The comedian was born 14 years prior to the year the series aired." And "The series aired between 2000 and 2015 inclusive." This is fine.

Need "It is a horror series with less than 10 episodes as of December 31, 2023." Could be one requirement: "The series is a horror series and had fewer than 10 episodes as of December 31, 2023." This is coherent.

Need "One of the showrunners of the series is also the founder of a talent management company." One requirement. It identifies relation between series, showrunner, company. But then "same talent management company" used for comedian special. Could combine? Maybe separate: (a) showrunner-founder relation; (b) comedian released first special under same company in early 2020s. They are independent? They both identify company but one through showrunner, one through comedian. Need both. Keep separate.

Need "interracial comedian" attribute.

Need "The comedian released his first stand-up comedy special under the talent management company in the early 2020s." Include first and under same.

Need "The person who played the role of a Nurse in the series has a full name." That's final requested attribute. Maybe "A person played the role of a Nurse in the series." Then "The requested answer is the full name of that person." But final answer is attribute. The instructions: "represent what must eventually be established." We can include "The person who played the role of a Nurse in the series has a full name that answers the question." Maybe.

Need avoid outputting answer. We don't know. No outside knowledge.

Need preserve role identity uncertainty. The nurse actor could be same as showrunner/founder/comedian? The question doesn't say. We should not assume equality/inequality. Our requirements can refer to roles separately. We must not say "different person". Just "the person who played role..." and "the comedian..." etc. If same? Not relevant. But maybe if we say "the comedian" separate from "the person who played Nurse", that might imply distinct? The grammar "the person who played..." and "the comedian" are different descriptions. It doesn't assert inequality. In requirements, we can maintain separate entities. That's fine, not assuming either.

Need preserve temporal attachment: less than 10 episodes as of Dec 31 2023 attached to series. Early 2020s attached to release of special. Born 14 years prior to year series aired. Aired between 2000-2015 inclusive attached to series.

Need "One of the showrunners" not necessarily all. "also the founder" relation same person. "talent management company" singular.

1. A series aired between 2000 and 2015 inclusive.
2. The series is a horror series with fewer than 10 episodes as of December 31, 2023.
3. One of the showrunners of the series is also the founder of a talent management company.
4. In the early 2020s, an interracial comedian released his first stand-up comedy special under that same talent management company.
5. The comedian was born 14 years prior to the year in which the series aired.
6. A person played the role of a Nurse in the series.
7. The requested full name is the full name of that person who played the role of a Nurse in the series.

Maybe too many? Minimum preserving structure. Could combine 1 and 2? "The series aired between 2000 and 2015 inclusive and is a horror series with less than 10 episodes as of Dec 31 2023." That's coherent series attributes. Yes. Then 3, 4, 5, 6, 7. But 7 maybe combines final attribute with 6. Requirement 6+7: "The full name of the person who played the role of a Nurse in the series is requested." But is that a requirement? It states the requested attribute. Could be one: "The requested answer is the full name of the person who played the role of a Nurse in the series." But candidate requirements should describe object/event/relation/requested attribute. This is exactly requested attribute. Include.

Maybe requirement 3 and 4 could be combined because they jointly identify the same talent management company? But they are independent conditions: showrunner-founder and comedian-special. The company is same. Could keep separate to avoid combining independent requirements? Actually the same company is a relation between showrunner-founder and comedian-special. We need both. Could combine into "There is a talent management company such that one of the showrunners of the series is its founder, and in the early 2020s an interracial comedian released his first stand-up comedy special under it." This is coherent around company. But it combines showrunner and comedian conditions. Instructions say do not combine independent requirements merely because they contribute to same final answer. They are independent but linked by same company. However, the company is a shared entity. Combining might be okay? But safer separate: one for showrunner-founder, one for comedian-special under same company. Need mention same company in second.

Requirement 5: birth relation depends on year series aired. Need "The comedian was born 14 years prior to the year the series aired." This is coherent relation between comedian and series. It uses series and comedian from earlier. Fine.

Could there be need to identify "the year the series mentioned above was aired" if series aired multiple years? We preserve as stated. "the year the series aired" within 2000-2015. If multiple years, ambiguous. But question says "the year", so okay.

Need no outside knowledge. We don't use.

But requirements can be separate. The instructions: minimum number preserving useful semantic structure. The question presents them as conditions on same series. Combining is okay? The instruction 3 says keep complementary conditions together when they jointly identify or verify same object. These conditions jointly identify series. So combine. Similarly 3 and 4? They jointly identify company. Could combine into one complex requirement: "One of the showrunners of the series is also the founder of a talent management company under which, in the early 2020s, an interracial comedian released his first stand-up comedy special." That is coherent around company. But it combines two independent facts (showrunner-founder and comedian-special). They are linked by same company, jointly identify company. Could combine. They do contribute to same final answer but also share company. Hmm.

Let's think of the underlying logical structure. To answer, need identify series S, then actor A who played Nurse in S. To identify S, constraints:

- S is horror.
- S has <10 episodes as of Dec 31 2023.
- S has showrunner P who is founder of company C.
- C is talent management company under which comedian D released first stand-up special in early 2020s.
- D is interracial.
- D born 14 years prior to year S aired.
Then A played Nurse in S. Full name A.

R3: One showrunner of S is also founder of C.
